``` | | **4. Inspect the Response** | The JSON will contain a `data` object with `attributes`. ``` | --- ### Sample Response Snippet (Simplified) ```json { "data": { "id": "dropbox.com", "type": "domains", "attributes": { "last_analysis_stats": { "harmless": 70, "malicious": 3, "suspicious": 1, "undetected": 26 }, "last_analysis_results": { "Kaspersky": { "category": "malicious", ... }, "McAfee": { "category": "harmless", ... } }, "threat_actor": [ { "name": "APT28", "confidence": 80, "description": "Russian state-sponsored group" } ] } } } ``` If the `threat_actor` array is empty or missing, it simply means no analysts have linked that domain to a known threat actor in the current dataset. --- ## Tips & Best Practices 1. **Rate Limits** – VirusTotal free tier allows ~4 requests/minute.
